title: Show the most recently updated cards first in every Kanbus board column
description:
## Behavior

In every Kanbus board column, list issue cards in reverse chronological order by updated_at: the most recently updated issue is at the top of that column.

This applies to every configured status, including Done; it is not limited to a particular semantic category. Moving an issue between columns or updating it should cause it to appear at the correct position in its destination column.

## Acceptance criteria

- Each column is ordered by updated_at descending.
- The first card in Done is the most recently updated issue in Done.
- The same rule applies independently to all other columns.
- Sorting updates correctly when issue data changes and does not change issue status or timestamps.

## Router test requirements

This is a live Issue Router test. Do not close this issue or request any issue status update; the router owns lifecycle status and must move successful work to the configured Review stage. In the structured result use `issue_updates: []` and `artifacts: []` when there are no additional issues or named artifacts to report. If an artifact is reported, each item must be an object with `name` and `ref` fields.
